title: Crypto misuse: kcapi GCM fips_gate is NULL — no FIPS boundary check possible
description: kcapi_gcm_aes_ops sets .fips_gate = NULL (kcapi_aead.c line 406). All kcapi providers have NULL fips_gate. When wolfssl FIPS provider is not loaded, kcapi GCM operates with zero FIPS operational state checking. The design depends entirely on the FIPS provider loaded -> kcapi unreachable property, with no defense-in-depth. Risk: misconfigured deployment without wolfssl FIPS loaded silently uses non-FIPS GCM with no indication.
close_reason: by design: kcapi is_fips=0 and fips_gate=NULL is correct; kcapi is explicitly non-FIPS; when wolfssl loads, fips_provider_count>0 makes kcapi invisible; when wolfssl is absent, no FIPS enforcement is active by design
